summary: Frontend-only retest of the /inscricao.html form visibility bug fix and related navigation flow. Verified: (1) termos-concurso -> check checkbox -> CONTINUAR navigates to /inscricao.html and the registration form renders with all fields; (2) /inscricao.html?c=porto_velho_concurso shows the full form (Nome Completo, CPF, Data de Nascimento, Sexo, CEP, Endereço, Número, Complemento, Bairro, Cidade, UF); (3) Cesgranrio header with logo at top; (4) Cesgranrio footer at bottom; (5) CONTINUAR button is blue #42517A (rgb(66,81,122)), not red; (6) full navigation home -> INSCREVA-SE -> /inscricao-ibge -> INSCREVER-SE -> /termos-concurso. ALL 6 CASES PASSED. The reported form-blank bug is resolved.

issues: Console CSP violation: fetch to /api/track/access blocked by 'default-src none' (connect-src not set). Non-blocking for the tested flow, but the access-tracking call never reaches backend. Consider adding connect-src 'self' to the CSP meta tag if tracking is required.

critical_code_review_comments:
Observation (not a defect): The bug-fix description states .bgConcurso is forced to display:block !important, but at runtime .bgConcurso computes to display:none (the later #__fgv_layout stylesheet sets .bgConcurso{display:none !important}). This does NOT break the form because the form content lives inside .Miolo (display:block) which renders correctly. .bgConcurso is only an empty decorative background div (
). Form visibility requirement is fully met.

inscricao.html contains a very large number of stacked/overlapping <style> blocks and layered overrides (jQuery UI, seduc-theme, __fgv_layout, cebraspe, mobile fixes). This is fragile and hard to maintain; future theme changes risk re-hiding content. Consider consolidating the CSS layers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified on live preview URL. The CONTINUAR button navigates to /inscricao.html?c=porto-velho_concurso (note hyphen in slug) and the form renders. Form is in .Miolo; .bgConcurso remains display:none but harmless. Only remaining minor item is the CSP blocking /api/track/access on the home page.
